name: verify_identity
description: Verify the caller's identity after lookup_user found them. For most employees, send the 6-digit code from their authenticator app. If lookup_user said the employee uses an Okta Verify push, send only the user_id and follow next_step (call it again after the caller approves). On success the server issues a verification that unlock_account uses automatically.

code.description: Exactly 6 digits, digits only, e.g. '048213'. Convert spoken numbers to digits and keep leading zeros. Leave empty for Okta Verify push employees.
